name: Saimin Appli de Netori Hame ~Kore made no Urami, Yari Kaeshite Yaru!~
original_name: 催眠アプリで寝取りハメ ～これまでの恨み、ヤり返してやる！～
source:
Misawa Kouta Is a very unfortunate boy, being bullied by his classmates.
The only classmate who talks to him is a girl by the name of Shibasaki Ayaka.
However, Ayaka has a boyfriend, Sekishima Kaoru, one of Kouta's bullies.
One night, while playing an online videogame and wondering how he could take revenge, he finds out about the existence of a Hypnosis app.
"This Hypnosis app is amazing" - Kouta witness firsthand the power of the app.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/103918416]Monolith[/url]]
translation:
三泽幸太是一个非常不幸的男孩，被同学欺负。
唯一和他说话的同学是一个名叫柴崎绫香的女孩。
然而，绫香有一个男朋友，关岛薰，是孝太的恶霸之一。
一天晚上，当他玩在线视频游戏并想知道如何报仇时，他发现了催眠应用程序的存在。
“这款催眠应用程序太棒了”- Kouta亲眼目睹了该应用程序的强大功能。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/103918416]Monolith[/url]]
